name: Speak with Renferrel
summary: At the Sepulcher, Apothecary Renferrel needs to discuss the tainted wolf hearts. High Executor Hadrec sends you back to the Royal Apothecary Society researcher with your findings.

sections.title: Summons from the Society
sections.body: After you help the Deathstalkers across Silverpine Forest, High Executor Hadrec gives you an urgent message from Apothecary Renferrel. Renferrel has studied the discolored wolf hearts gathered from local wildlife and needs you at once.

sections.title: Alchemical Curiosities
sections.body: Apothecary Renferrel works for the Royal Apothecary Society in a laboratory inside the Sepulcher crypt. He studies how dark magic and disease are changing Silverpine's beasts, bringing alchemical research together with military reports from the front.

faq.answer: Apothecary Renferrel is in the Sepulcher crypt in central Silverpine Forest, beside his alchemy equipment and a short walk from High Executor Hadrec.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Renferrel want to speak with me?
faq.answer: Renferrel has studied discolored hearts from Silverpine wolves and found strange signs in their corruption. He needs to investigate further and report to the Undercity.
High Executor Hadrec, the Forsaken commander at the Sepulcher, gives you Renferrel's summons after you return from helping the Deathstalkers.

aliases: next quest after speak with renferrel
faq.answer: Your conversation with Renferrel leads to further work linking the Sepulcher's alchemical research with senior figures in the Undercity, including Apothecary Zinge.

angles.text: As an Undead, you may hear of the Royal Apothecary Society's work alongside military command at the Sepulcher, where researchers study unusual creatures in Silverpine.
As a member of the Horde, you can learn how taint is changing the beasts of Silverpine.
